scripts.dev: npm run build && concurrently -k -n vite,pages "vite build --watch --logLevel warn" "wrangler pages dev dist --port 8788 --live-reload"
scripts.typecheck: tsc -p tsconfig.json && tsc -p tsconfig.functions.json && tsc -p tsconfig.node.json
scripts.deploy: npm run build && wrangler pages deploy dist --project-name k-tracker
